title: Single-cell sequencing in pan-cancer research: Decoding heterogeneity, tumor microenvironment, and clinical translation.
snippet: Single-cell sequencing (SCS) technologies have revolutionized cancer research by overcoming the critical limitations of bulk sequencing, enabling unprecedented resolution in deciphering intratumoral heterogeneity and the tumor microenvironment (TME).
